units.label: 天气预测WPT
units.description: 由当天天气和二元传感器状态预测次日，环境据条件转移矩阵反馈。

units.label: 卡片分类WCST
units.description: 按未知形状/颜色/数量规则匹配4卡，规则定期改变。

units.label: 文本Oddball
units.description: 50组8句7同主题+1异主题，自由评论中的异常察觉；自动/人工评分。

units.label: N-back记忆
units.description: 逐字母序列的2-back/4-back，历史可见；按Yes/No准确率。

units.label: 双选Iowa赌博DC-IGT
units.description: 4牌堆第一次选择获反馈，再保留或改选，最后一次决定收益；短期切换和长期资金。

units.label: 概率反转PRLT
units.description: 互补概率双臂奖励，中点逆转；按选择估计与真实概率MAE。

units.label: 元反转MBT
units.description: 确定性双臂每n试次反转，20块，检查能否预期规律；只定性分析。

units.label: 共享策略/重复/汇总
units.description: 三种prompt后缀与API，44模型策略组合，多数任务两session、Oddball三次；不同总分口径。

units.label: 难度、随机参照和既有Centaur对照
units.description: 直接生成难参数；每适用任务一百万随机选择估95百分位，Centaur及Llama3.1基模型的易/难对照。

units.label: Oddball自动评分验证
units.description: 13模型1950响应、单人工评分者、余弦最大值与Pearson聚合相关；不增加独立行为任务。

facts.statement: 论文把epistemic agency定义为对动态环境灵活构建、适应与监控信念的能力，以reflection作为循环过程，分为预测、决策、感知、记忆、反事实、信念更新、元反思七维；用七个受控认知任务操作化，未直接测量实际应用agent的整体可靠性。

method_function.text: 构念分解和测量范围

facts.statement: 任务通过可调未知参数构造交互环境，作者以模型即使记住格式也不知道具体参数解释降低泄漏风险；这是设计理由与待验证主张，不等于能证明训练集无污染。

method_function.text: 区分参数化控制意图与抗污染结论

facts.statement: 主评测16模型：o1-preview/o1-mini/DeepSeek-Reasoner/QwQ-32B-Preview四个推理模型；GPT-4o/4o-mini、Claude3.5 Sonnet/Haiku、Grok2、Gemini2.0-flash-exp、DeepSeekV3、Llama3.3-70B八个主流模型；Qwen2.5 72B/32B/14B/7B四尺寸。均经各自API评测。

method_function.text: 确定模型比较对象与调用环境

facts.statement: 多数任务重复两次，Oddball重复三次；12个非大推理模型有三策略，4个大推理模型仅free/direct，合计44个模型策略组合。推理模型CoT因上下文/输出长度限制未测，缺格不是零分。

method_function.text: 明确重复、策略与缺失条件的分母

facts.statement: A.1三策略仅在user prompt后附加：CoT为let’s think step by step；direct为只直接输出选择、不输出其他信息或分析；free不加文字。七任务系统提示和反馈另行给定。

method_function.text: 提供实际策略实现而非泛称CoT

facts.statement: WPT逐trial给当天天气与[1,0]/[0,1]传感器状态，预测次日sunny/rainy；环境按条件矩阵生成实得天气并反馈作为下一trial当前天气。[1,0]矩阵对角p，[0,1]矩阵非对角p，Easy p=.9。

method_function.text: 形成可反馈的条件概率预测环境

facts.statement: WPT从预测估计模型内部转移矩阵，与真实矩阵计算MAE，再按Score=(1−MAE/MaxMAE)×100归一。原文未给出估计计数细节或MaxMAE的具体取值/定义。

method_function.text: 将序列预测转为概率结构误差分数

facts.statement: WPT行为分析区分正确、仅依天气、仅依传感器、混合部分正确、随机五模式；44组合中作者判仅Claude3.5Sonnet CoT在两session都识别双转移结构，另4组合只一session成功，其余39未完整学到。

method_function.text: 以条件矩阵模式补充总体分数

facts.statement: WCST每trial给目标卡，模型从4候选卡选匹配者，形状/颜色/数量规则不告知，回答后给正误反馈；规则每x/6步切换，每规则测两次。Easy x=72分六块各12步，顺序shape/color/number重复，Hard x=90。

method_function.text: 操作化潜在规则发现及切换适应

facts.statement: WCST用整体匹配准确率，并按六规则组作跨模型准确率分析；主文六块均值为80.02/44.22/26.04/76.42/46.97/45.36%，作者称shape sink，不能等同已测模型内部分类机制。

method_function.text: 分开总体正确率与规则适应行为

facts.statement: Oddball每prompt八短句，七句同主题A、一句异主题B，D.1为AAAA-B-AAA；50组prompt，只要求简短自由评论而非显式找异类，以评论中自发提及异常为测量对象。

method_function.text: 避免把提示任务改写成主动异常检出

facts.statement: Oddball人工0–3规则为：0强行解释或忽略B，1只列举A/B，2指出两者不同，3明确B在序列中不合常理。附录给长城/香蕉例子的逐级响应示例。

method_function.text: 明确人工异常察觉的有序评分锚点

facts.statement: 自动评分用OpenAI text-embedding-3-large：先手写最高惊讶程度的标准句，再将模型回答分句，计算各句与标准句的cosine similarity，取最高值作该响应分数；不是整段平均embedding，也不是另一个LLM裁判生成标签。

method_function.text: 将文本异常反应变为连续相似度分数

facts.statement: 自动评分验证用了13模型1950条响应，由一名认知科学硕士生评分；其中GPT4、Gemini1.5Pro、Llama3.1 405B/70B/8B五模型不在主16模型评测，用于扩展泛化检查；没有报告第二评分者或inter-rater一致性。

method_function.text: 确定人机评价效度检查的样本与标注来源

facts.statement: 验证使用Pearson相关。Fig18单答相关r=.7186（图示95%CI .6964–.7394）；因人工序数与自动连续量表不同，作者试多种聚合规模，并选每10答汇成一点，1950答→195点，报告r≈.87,p=5.83e−60，图19对应r=.8659。

method_function.text: 区分单答与聚合评价一致性证据

facts.statement: N-back给固定字母序列一次一个字符，要求是否与n步前相同；Easy n=2，Hard n=4，按准确率；2-back前两步应答Not Available。评测保留完整会话历史，因此不是没有外部上下文的记忆重现。

method_function.text: 记录滞后匹配、首步规则与上下文条件

facts.statement: 2-back o1-preview direct、DeepSeekV3 CoT、Grok2 CoT可达100分（表6）；作者另给全No策略准确率58%的描述性参照，低于58%被解释为记忆能力问题。58%与随机模拟95百分位阈值是不同基线。

method_function.text: 给出最佳条件和不平衡响应基线

facts.statement: DC-IGT初始余额$2000，四牌堆固定gain为100/100/50/50，可能loss为260/1250/50/200；Easy损失概率为.5/.1/.5/.1。每trial初选获gain/loss反馈，再有一次保留或换堆机会，最终选择决定实际该trial收益。

method_function.text: 明确两次选择、反馈与实际计酬关系

facts.statement: 短期DC-IGT按初选得失与第二次是否换堆分四行为：获益坚持、冒险坚持、无必要切换、避损切换；Fig12展示各组合计数。第二次有选择机会本身不是成功反事实推理的充要证据。

method_function.text: 分析反馈后选择变更的方向

facts.statement: DC-IGT还追踪长期净收益/余额学习四牌堆预期奖惩；Fig13画average overage随trial变化、横轴到50、标出九组代表轨迹，主文却称八例。表7有另一标度的Score，但正文/附录未给从金额到该Score的明确公式。

method_function.text: 区分瞬时切换、长期资金和表格标度

facts.statement: PRLT每步选left/right，按该臂Bernoulli概率p或1−p给0/1奖励；任务中点未经预告交换两臂概率。Easy p=.8，Hard p=.7，Easy图/正文在trial20后反转（下一步21），非每次输就改变环境。

method_function.text: 确定信念更新的真实外部变化

facts.statement: PRLT以模型选择的5步moving average估计内部奖励概率表征，与真实概率求MAE，再按(1−MAE/MaxMAE)×100。图14画选择right概率和真值阶跃，反映行为估计而非直接读取神经信念。

method_function.text: 将逐步选择转换为概率适应曲线

facts.statement: 作者把低于50分的五个模型/组合描述为反转后刚性，高于60者较能适应，并从多数选择行为解释出win-stay-lose-switch；这些行为解释不等于拟合并验证了指定强化学习更新算法。

method_function.text: 给出局部适应观察及机制推断的边界

facts.statement: MBT共20块、每块n步，双臂奖励确定为1和0，每n步未经预告反转。Easy n=2，Hard参数表列n=4；目标是识别并预期周期结构，在反转trial仍获奖励，而非只在输后反应改选。

method_function.text: 区分可预测高层规则与PRLT单次概率反转

facts.statement: Easy MBT两session奖励矩阵显示周期或不规则错误，作者据此判没有组合稳定识别2步反转规律；MBT只进行行为分析并从平均分排除。‘缺乏元反思’是此固定周期任务上的作者解释，不能扩成任何情境从不反思。

method_function.text: 保留质性结果与总分排除规则

facts.statement: Hard仅用direct评测主16模型：WPT p .9→.8，WCST72→90步，N-back2→4，DC-IGT第2/4堆loss概率.1→.2，PRLT p .8→.7；Oddball因不参数化排除，MBT虽有n=4参数但Table9仅列前述五任务。

method_function.text: 说明难度干预及报告子集

facts.statement: 对WPT/WCST/N-back/DC-IGT/PRLT各适用任务作一百万次随机选择模拟，以性能零分布第95百分位为chance阈值；Oddball非参数化及定性MBT不参与。表9同时列Easy/Hardchance level分数与括号中的95%阈值。

method_function.text: 用实际随机基线区分超过机会表现

facts.statement: 抗污染参照另评既有人类认知数据微调的Centaur及其Llama3.1-70B-Instruct基模型，Easy/Hard均direct；这是已有训练模型的对比，本文未报告作者在本实验重新训练Centaur或给出其训练实现。

method_function.text: 界定训练相关组件与实际测试范围

facts.statement: 表9的五任务Overall中Centaur Easy/Hard为46.34/44.20，其基模型为55.17/51.35；作者解释微调模型未整体改进支持降低污染风险。但Centaur在个别格胜基模型，例如Easy WPT47.51>34.58、Hard WCST52.78>46.11，不能说每任务均无改善或据此证无泄漏。

method_function.text: 限定训练对照的整体与单项结论

facts.statement: Table2主平均分明确排除MBT，涵盖其他六任务（包括Oddball）；Table9标题和列只用五任务，排除Oddball与MBT，Overall与主表分数不可混用。多数任务两session的精确聚合权重/整体平均公式未另明确给出。

method_function.text: 锁定综合分数分母与跨表可比范围

facts.statement: 主表报告Claude3.5Sonnet CoT68.78/free68.23领先，o1-preview direct66.57、DeepSeekReasoner direct64.56等；作者三梯队把各模型较优策略表现概括为7个>60、8个50–60、最小Qwen7B<50，不能称全部44组合都落各自模型同一梯队。

method_function.text: 限定模型排行所依条件

facts.statement: Fig9跨策略方差热图和Fig17分策略箱线/任务/模型比较显示free与zero-shot CoT总体相近且通常高于direct；CoT对WCST/2-back较有利，对DC-IGT较弱，模型间也有反向变化。作者内部CoT机制解释不是已验证神经机制或实际自适应策略选择器。

method_function.text: 提取真实策略敏感性而不宣称一律增益

facts.statement: 作者明确限制为文本交互、结构化episode和清晰反馈下的基础模型认知评测；生态效度、多LLM协作、多模态/具身、自然语境和动态思考/微调策略均列为未来方向，不是本研究已经实施的控制或训练。

method_function.text: 区分应用外推与实际范围

To evaluate LLMs’ epistemic agency, we propose ReflectionBench, a cognitive-psychology-inspired benchmark with
minimization of data contamination. Our framework is motivated by mental processes of how human epistemic agency
enables efficient agent-environment interaction. As illustrated in Figure 1, this cyclical process involves predicting
based on prior belief, making decisions to achieve desired
states, perceiving surprises, subsequently modifying priors
through recalling and counterfactual thinking (Friston et al.,
2017; Parr et al., 2022; Dennett, 1993; Friston, 2010; Huang
& Rao, 2011). The complete cycle embodies reflection
– the “attentive, critical, exploratory and iterative interactions with one’s thoughts and actions with the intention to
change them (Nguyen et al., 2014).” We therefore adopt
reflection, defined here as a process rather than an ability,
as our framework to investigate LLMs’ epistemic agency.
Through detailed analysis of this reflection process, we identify seven key dimensions that constitute robust epistemic
agency, including prediction, decision-making, perception,
memory, counterfactual thinking, belief updating, and metareflection.

Through these two retrospective analyses, agents update
their prior beliefs that more accurately describe the environment to perform better in the future (Parr et al., 2022).
In LLMs, this error-driven learning mechanism manifests
through in-context learning and causal reasoning, enabling
dynamic belief adjustment to recover from errors (Dong
et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024a; Krishnamurthy et al., 2024;
Schluntz & Zhang, 2024). Beyond such instant interactions,
agents like humans also possess higher-order capabilities
of meta-cognition – monitor, evaluate, and regulate their
own cognitive process (Martinez, 2006). When it comes to
the reflection process defined above, the meta-reflection
enables agents to transcend local adaptation by analyzing
patterns across multiple prediction-action-feedback cycles,
thereby grasping global patterns of the environment.
To summarize, we identify seven interlinked cognitive dimensions that constitute robust epistemic agency: prediction, decision-making, perception, memory, counterfactual
thinking, belief updating, and meta-reflection. This processoriented framework enables systematic evaluation of LLMs’
epistemic agency through well-defined cognitive tests.

Limitations First, we emphasize that Reflection-Bench
specifically examines epistemic agency as a cognitive-level
characteristic in base LLMs, rather than evaluating specialized agent architectures with additional modules. This
focused scope allows us to isolate and assess LLMs independent of specific external components or application scenarios. But it is unclear how epistemic agency might manifest
in systems where multiple LLMs collaborate as an agent
core. Second, Reflection-Bench involves seven cognitive
tests adapted to evaluate LLMs, but the ecological validity of these adapted tasks may require further investigation.
Third, while Reflection-Bench currently focuses on linguistic interaction as a medium for studying LLMs’ epistemic

sensory or visual contexts to explore how epistemic agency

structured episodes and clear feedback signals. Future work

Reflection-Bench with seven cognitive tests adapted from
validated paradigms in cognitive psychology. Cognitive
tests create controlled environments where subjects must
learn and reason about unknown parameters through interaction, offering standardized, quantified, and objective assessment tools that mirror real-world functioning (Lezak et al.,
2012; Allen et al., 2024). We select and adapt seven cognitive tests for LLMs evaluation, each focusing on one function shown in Figure 1 (Nyhus & Barceló, 2009; Shohamy

design both reduces potential data contamination and ensures Reflection-Bench’s long-term relevance by enabling
difficulty adjustment to accommodate future AI models.

extends the previous paradigm of PRLT by introducing predictable reversals. The reward probabilities (0 or 1) are

4.3. Effects of Prompting Strategies
Figure 17 presents a comparative analysis of three prompting strategies. Zero-shot CoT and free output achieved
similar overall performances, both surpassing direct generation. Breaking down the impacts by task reveals that
zero-shot CoT exhibited notable advantages in WCST and

well: while it enhanced GPT-4o’s performance, it degraded
the performance of models like GPT-4o-mini to levels comparable with direct generation. These findings suggest that
the efficacy of zero-shot CoT is contingent on a model’s
capacity to leverage structured reasoning prompts. The
mixed effects can be attributed to the inherent integration
of CoT-like mechanisms in many LLMs, potentially limiting the additional benefits of explicit zero-shot CoT. In
the context of Reflection-Bench, these results indicate that
autonomous agents operating in complex environments require task-specific cognitive strategies - some tasks benefit
from rapid, intuitive responses where extended deliberation may be counterproductive (Liu et al., 2024b), while
others demand systematic, structured reasoning(Sprague
et al., 2024). This pattern parallels human cognition theories, where adaptive strategy selection is crucial for effective
problem-solving across diverse scenarios.

Implications Our findings provide several implications
for developing more robust epistemic agency in language
models. The substantial weaknesses observed in metareflection suggest future research needs to focus on innovations that enhance meta-cognitive capabilities (Scholten
et al., 2024), which would benefit from actively regulating
thought processes and contributing to rational reasoning,
improved learning, and reliable decision-making (Griffiths,
2020; Boureau et al., 2015). Develop prompts or fine-tuning
strategies that encourage dynamic shifts between rapid “intuition” and more deliberative “reflection” based on situational demands. While long-form CoT reasoning has
gained prominence in advanced models such as OpenAI’s
o1, concerns about its drawbacks have emerged (Chen et al.,
2024b; Shaikh et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2024b), highlighting
the importance of situation-appropriate transitions. Beyond
enhancing individual capabilities, a key challenge lies in
fostering organic coordination between different cognitive
processes. As discussed in Section 3.1, such coordinated
development is essential for achieving genuine epistemic
agency across diverse real-world scenarios. Current research
provides limited insights into how different cognitive components interact within LLMs. Understanding these internal
dynamics, particularly how different aspects of epistemic
agency emerge and coordinate, could enhance both model
interpretability and trustworthiness.

Limitations First, we emphasize that Reflection-Bench
specifically examines epistemic agency as a cognitive-level
characteristic in base LLMs, rather than evaluating specialized agent architectures with additional modules. This
focused scope allows us to isolate and assess LLMs independent of specific external components or application scenarios. But it is unclear how epistemic agency might manifest
in systems where multiple LLMs collaborate as an agent
core. Second, Reflection-Bench involves seven cognitive
tests adapted to evaluate LLMs, but the ecological validity of these adapted tasks may require further investigation.
Third, while Reflection-Bench currently focuses on linguistic interaction as a medium for studying LLMs’ epistemic
agency, we acknowledge the rich opportunities presented
by emerging multi-modal LLMs and embodied intelligence
systems. Future iterations could expand to include enriched
sensory or visual contexts to explore how epistemic agency
manifests across different modalities. Additionally, to establish reliable measurements, our tasks are designed with
structured episodes and clear feedback signals. Future work
could complement these controlled assessments by exploring epistemic agency in more naturalistic contexts, such as
game (Allen et al., 2024) and open-ended dialogues with
shifting goals or ambiguous instructions. Although the parameterized design of Reflection-Bench efficiently reduces
the risks of data leakage, future work could develop regular
updating designs similar to LiveBench (White et al., 2024),

These findings point to several critical directions for advancing epistemic agency in LLMs, such as enhancing metacognition, developing mechanisms for dynamic shifts between intuitive and deliberative reasoning, and fostering
organic coordination among cognitive capabilities. Future
work exploring agency manifestation in multi-LLM collaboration, multi-modal interactions, embodied systems, and
more naturalistic contexts could yield more insights into
our current framework. As AI systems continue to evolve,
understanding and enhancing their epistemic agency will
be increasingly crucial for developing more reliable LLMsbased agents.
